items.title: Add receipt proof client and verifier
items.context: Add AuthorityClient proof fetch, proof schema, trusted key/digest handling, signature verification, inputDigest and decisionDigest recomputation, production key classification, and precise fail reasons.

items.title: Add receipt-ref writer command and store support
items.context: Expose lattice authority receipt verify, write authority-receipt-refs.json only for production gate_decision receipts, preserve previous refs, and keep invalid/local-test diagnostics non-gating.

items.title: Wire idempotent TEST gate consumption
items.context: Read authority-receipt-refs.json during validate or TEST gate enforcement, consume matching receipts idempotently, derive strongEvidenceConsumed only from the gate adapter, and preserve local/shadow behavior by default.

items.title: Wire DONE gate policy and status output
items.context: Require distinct DONE receipt unless policy allows TEST coverage, re-check head/material before DONE, show readiness/verified/consumed as separate facts, and prevent local diagnostic receipts from setting productionDone.

items.title: Add CLI smoke tests and process fact coverage
items.context: Cover valid proof, corrupt signature, digest mismatch, local-test key, story/phase/material mismatch, writer idempotency, enforce blocking, shadow non-blocking, and process fact registry consistency.
